title: Expose aggregate closing-job states, reasons and UTC dates through diagnostics
outcome: A privacy-preserving diagnostics route makes resident closing-job distribution observable without opening the live store.
acceptance: GET /api/diagnostics/closing-jobs returns only aggregate resident closing-job counts by terminal/retrying state, by fixed reason category (focusScopeChanged/sourceRefused/maxAttempts/other, derived only from stored attempts and the producing code paths' constant message prefixes, with anything else counted as other), and by UTC adopted-at day (unknown for invalid dates), plus serverInstanceId and revision; no job text, identities, paths or commands are exposed.

The handler performs one non-mutating pass under StateInner without cloning job bodies, opening a store, retrying work or changing revision; HTTP fixture controls cover mixed sessions/states/reasons/dates, unknown legacy data, UTC boundaries, privacy and unchanged custody.

Focused author validation demonstrates the route's behavioral RED then GREEN on recorded inputs; the green candidate passes cargo fmt --check and the independent full review pair before integration handoff.
